## Problem

Who needs this capability, and what currently fails or costs too much?

## Proposed behavior

Describe one reviewable increment and its milestone.

## Acceptance criteria

How will correctness or usefulness be demonstrated? Name the relevant baseline for an efficiency claim.

## Alternatives and limits

Explain simpler alternatives and the boundaries of the proposal.
